story_director_gate.verdict: GO: the moonwater story is causal, reciprocal, visually ownable, and its destination remains honestly unfinished.

story_selling_gate.selected_concept_process_card: Card 20 - Saveable Lesson From One Scene

stage_scene_gate.action: They carry one table into a dry home, stabilize it as moonwater rises, row with opposite strokes until the raft circles, rotate their oars toward alignment, then make synchronized strokes out through the old wake.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Their attention moves from mutual certainty, to divided practical focus, to shared bafflement, to reciprocal laughter, to coordinated experimentation.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Eye-lines meet over the table, split toward separate demands, converge on the circular wake, reconnect at the turn, and finally alternate between each other and the unfinished horizon.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: The table changes from shared furniture to stable work surface to raft; separately owned oars move from opposed strokes, through visible realignment, into synchronized backward strokes on opposite outer sides.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The widening circular wake and resting moment before the oars realign create the quiet recognition beat.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: Opposed effort produces rotation; reciprocal recognition produces an observable change in method rather than a falsely solved destination.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: Being lost stops reading as evidence of a wrong partner and becomes the condition in which both people keep learning one next maneuver.

agent_alignment.instruction: The copy, moonwater action engine, identity prompts and QA all serve cold-viewer recognition, equal relationship motion and partner-sendability.
